voiceover:
[conversational] Your phone and laptop already do voice typing, and it's free.

Most people never touch it. Talking is way faster than typing, but raw dictation comes out messy, with filler words and weird punctuation. That's the real problem.

So here's the fix. On Windows, press the Windows key plus H and just talk. On a Mac, turn on Dictation in your keyboard settings. On your phone, tap the mic on Gboard or the iPhone keyboard.

[whispers] Now the trick. Paste that messy text into ChatGPT and say: "Clean this up. Remove filler words, fix punctuation, keep my meaning."

[confident] That's it. You get clean text you can actually send.

[serious] Honest catch: it's a small extra step, so a paid app may feel smoother. But before you pay, try this. And don't paste anything private into ChatGPT.

[curious] What do you type the most: emails, messages or notes?

[playful] Send this to the friend who still types every email super slowly.
